# Apache Arrow

> > A cross-language development platform for in-memory analytics, providing columnar data format and libraries for high-performance data processing across C++, Python, Java, R, Go, Rust, and other languages.

Apache Arrow includes ADBC (Arrow Database Connectivity) for Arrow-native database access, Flight RPC for efficient data transfer, and comprehensive APIs for working with columnar data. The project supports integration with PostgreSQL, SQLite, and other databases, with bindings available through conda-forge, CRAN, and language-specific package managers.

## Key Topics

- Apache Arrow - columnar in-memory data format
- ADBC (Arrow Database Connectivity) - database connectivity API
- Arrow Flight - RPC framework for data transfer
- PyArrow - Python bindings
- C++ API - core implementation
- Driver Manager - ADBC driver loading and management
- PostgreSQL driver - ADBC database driver
- SQLite driver - ADBC database driver
- Java bindings - JVM integration
- R package - statistical computing integration
- GLib bindings - C API with GObject introspection
- IPC (Inter-Process Communication) - serialization format
- Dataset API - multi-file data reading
- CUDA integration - GPU acceleration

## Getting Started

- [Apache Arrow Homepage](https://arrow.apache.org): Homepage for Apache Arrow: columnar format for fast data interchange

## ADBC (Arrow Database Connectivity)

- [ADBC Documentation Home](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/18/index.html): ADBC 18 documentation home: Arrow-native database connectivity APIs
- [C++ Driver Manager](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/17/cpp/driver_manager.html): ADBC C++ Driver Manager installation and usage guide
- [C++ Driver Manager (v23 dev)](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/main/cpp/driver_manager.html): ADBC 23 dev: C++ Driver Manager installation and usage documentation
- [Building ADBC Drivers](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/18/cpp/driver_example.html): C++ tutorial for building ADBC drivers using driver framework library
- [Driver Architecture](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/main/format/how_manager.html): ADBC driver architecture: how drivers and manager work together
- [Static Linking Guide](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/main/cpp/static_linking.html): ADBC static linking guide with CMake options for multiple drivers
- [PostgreSQL Driver](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/main/driver/postgresql.html): PostgreSQL driver documentation with libpq wrapper and connection setup

## Language-Specific ADBC Guides

- [Python ADBC](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/18/python/index.html): Python ADBC documentation index with DBAPI and driver manager guides
- [Java Quickstart](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/main/java/quickstart.html): Java quickstart guide for ADBC with PostgreSQL driver and Maven setup
- [R PostgreSQL Driver](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcpostgresql): R package reference for ADBC PostgreSQL driver with usage examples
- [R SQLite Driver](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/current/r/adbcsqlite): R package reference for ADBC SQLite driver with installation guide

## Cookbooks and Examples

- [Java Arrow Flight Cookbook](https://arrow.apache.org/cookbook/java/flight.html): Java cookbook for Arrow Flight RPC client-server implementation

## API Reference

- [PyArrow IPC Module Source](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/_modules/pyarrow/ipc.html): PyArrow IPC module source code for record batch serialization
- [ArrowCUDA Context Class](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/c_glib/arrow-cuda-glib/class.Context.html): ArrowCUDA Context class reference for GLib CUDA bindings
- [FileSystemDatasetFactory Class](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/c_glib/arrow-dataset-glib/class.FileSystemDatasetFactory.html): FileSystemDatasetFactory class API reference for C GLib bindings
- [IPCFileFormat Class](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/c_glib/arrow-dataset-glib/class.IPCFileFormat.html): IPCFileFormat class reference for Arrow Dataset GLib API
- [FileSystemDatasetWriteOptions Constructor](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/c_glib/arrow-dataset-glib/ctor.FileSystemDatasetWriteOptions.new.html): Constructor reference for FileSystemDatasetWriteOptions in C GLib
- [ADBC General Index](https://arrow.apache.org/adbc/main/genindex.html): ADBC 23 dev general index for API reference and documentation
